_comment: The whole voiceover script. Each scene is a list of lines; each line is one voice clip (the video shows no subtitles, so `text` is only heard, never shown). `speech` (optional) is what the voice says when it should differ from `text`. `pad` (optional) adds extra seconds after the line so an animation can finish. Scene ids must match SCENE_COMPONENTS in src/GojiVideo.tsx; the scenes time their animations against these lines, so if you add or remove a line, check that scene too.

lines.text: 紅通通的枸杞，台灣也能種嗎？
不過，在台灣種枸杞有一定的難度，
全台灣的枸杞種植面積，
大約只有十四個足球場那麼大。
總結一下：台灣可以種枸杞，但種得很少；
我們吃到的枸杞，幾乎都是進口的喔！
